examples.title: Restarting, reconnecting and failed
examples.description: The state takes over the page and cannot be dismissed (here Restarting closes itself after three seconds, as the page would when the host answers): the host is not answering, so the page behind it would show nothing true. restarting lists the steps, reconnecting counts the attempts (backing off 1, 2, 4, 8 s) with Retry now, and failed says what to check, how to start the host again with a Copy button, and offers Keep waiting. There is no restart-again action, because the route that restarts lives on the host that is not answering.
examples.code: (phase = undefined)} check="That Interborough is still running on this machine, and that its address is reachable from this browser." command="bun run start" onKeepWaiting={() => { phase = 'reconnecting'; attempt = 1; }} > {#snippet details()} fetch failed: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3000 {/snippet}
